notes: The portable C++ TCK checks the aggregate reply rule for one HLA_EVOKED Cancel Attribute Ownership Acquisition invocation. It requests three attributes; the owner transfers one, denies one, and leaves one pending. The requester must observe an acquisition notification, an unavailable reply, and a cancellation confirmation for the respective disjoint subsets, covering exactly the requested set. The scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ API and the C++ standard library. It does not claim HLA_IMMEDIATE, Java parity, independent-provider testing, or general conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attributeOwnershipAcquisition, attributeOwnershipDivestitureIfWanted, attributeOwnershipReleaseDenied, and cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition with three standard ownership callbacks
